findings.worldwideMethodConclusion: Must-hit-by jackpots can become positive-EV near a ceiling, but the crossover depends critically on base RTP, contribution rate, seed/reset and the actual trigger distribution. Uniform trigger assumptions are manufacturer-specific and must not be imported into Botemania without evidence.
